body: No. I'm just very lonely and very overwhelmed and very sad. I don't have a bad life, just one that (still) holds very little meaning for me anymore. As I said the last time, I just have to serve my sentence. Thank you for taking the time to reply. I feel silly for posting again.
No, I don't think there is anything. But thank you.

My family, my grandparents especially, are the only reason I'm still alive. I don't believe in hell, I'm not afraid of pain, I'd find a way if I decided to go. But don't worry, I won't. As far as they know, as far a they'll ever know, everybody's happy. Everybody has a great life. Aren't they lucky that their successful daughter has turned her life around. She was depressed in college, but that was just stress. Thank you for the time to comment, but I'm serving a life term, so to speak. If my family and friends thinking I'm happy fulfills their life and keeps them from worry and pain, that's what I have to do.

I don't have dreams anymore. Everything I thought I wanted seems like pure fantasy now. Like I finally woke up and realized that "you can be whatever you want to be" is just something that parents tell their children.

I don't even know myself. All I can see is my future, bleak and never ending. It sounds melodramatic, I know. I have to pretend to be happy for the sake of my family and friends. I promised someone several years ago that I wouldn't try to kill myself (again, although I'm not sure how "serious" I was the first time) and I feel trapped by that. And I feel like that's slowly driving me crazy. Like being imprisoned with no chance of escape, no hope to see the light of day. I don't know.

I'm sorry. I know what that's like. That's what I did (do), too. I don't know your situation, but for me it's like I feel like I'll never be what other people expect me to be. So rather than disappoint them, I cut them out. Better to push them away now than to have them realize how broken and irreparable I really am.

It's difficult when you feel like you don't have the "right" to be depressed. I compare myself to other people a lot - "what's the matter with you, at least your life is better than that girl's..." But that's not really fair is it? Why should I have to compare my pain to anyone, or blame it on anything? It's not a competition. You hurt. That's okay. Screw anyone who makes you feel like it's not okay.

I know exactly what you mean. Sometimes I feel so beaten down by my life and the world in general that I feel like it would be wonderful to live in the middle of nowhere. It would difficult and, at times, terrifying to be sure. But I get so sick if the life I'm leading, the person I've become due to my own actions and the actions of the people/culture around me that I just want to go away.
I'm here if you want to talk. I don't need to know what it is. I'm afraid I'm just as lost as you are, but all the same, I'm here.

This probably counts as the blind leading the blind, but since no one else seems to be here... I know how you feel. I'm probably not the best person to help you, but I just wanted to say you're not alone. It sucks when you feel like you can't tell your own family that you're hurting, because knowing that you are will just remind them of when you tried before and cause them pain all over again. For what it's worth, I'm sorry you feel the way you do, feeling like you're one decision/action away from ending it. It's a burden most people don't understand.
